To detect neutrinos efficiently given their tiny cross-section, experiments must satisfy:
Kilotons to Megatons of active target material.
Deep underground installation (under thousands of meters of water equivalent, m.w.e.) to block cosmic ray muons.
Placing detectors near megawatt accelerators or multi-gigawatt nuclear reactors.
